subject: SOC 2 Type II — onboarding essentials and evidence starter sheet
messages:
From: Oliver Price <oliver.price@acmecloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 Type II onboarding for Acme Cloud

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting an internal procurement review for Redwood’s platform and need to collect your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a minimal evidence list to scope our audit team’s intake. Specifically:  
- Full Type II report (period and attest).
- A short list of artifacts you typically share (logs retention, change control, user access reviews, configuration baselines).
- Preferred secure transfer method (SFTP / secure Drive / vendor portal).

Target timeline: our audit window is late September — we’d like to confirm materials by Sep 16 so our external team (Kestrel Security) can ingest.

CCing procurement for visibility.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Price
Head of Procurement, Acme Cloud
oliver.price@acmecloud.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Price <oliver.price@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II onboarding for Acme Cloud

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note. Happy to help and welcome the chance to work with Acme. Quick summary and what we can share now:  

1) Documents we can share today (attached):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (covering 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31) — attached as PDF.
- Evidence index (CSV) mapping common artifact names to our internal locations.
- Bridge-letter template (Word) — if you need an attestation for a gap window we can sign a short bridge.

2) Minimal evidence we typically provide on first pass:
- System change log samples (recent quarter)
- User access review output (redacted)
- Backup configuration snapshot + retention policy excerpt
- Centralized log retention policy and one sample log export
- Incident response runbook excerpt

3) Transfer options:
- Preferred: one-time SFTP drop (we’ll provide credentials and a short onboarding guide).
- Alternate: Customer-secured Google Drive folder with enforced account list.
- If neither works, we can use a vendor portal with time-limited links.

I’ve attached the report and the evidence-index.csv to this reply. Marissa (Security) and Rishi (Compliance) are on the thread if the audit team wants row-level mapping or clarification.

Next steps: please confirm (A) which transfer option you prefer, and (B) whether Kestrel needs a bridge letter signed and on what timing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_report_2025-09-01_to_2026-08-31.pdf, evidence-index-ACME.csv
From: Kestrel Security <audit@kestrelsec.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Oliver Price <oliver.price@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II onboarding for Acme Cloud

Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from the audit team:  
- Confirm the audit period covered by the Type II report (start / end).
- We’ll take an SFTP transfer. Can you send the SFTP instruction file and a contact for credentials provisioning?
- For evidence, can you provide the sample change log, one access review, and a copy of the incident runbook as redacted PDFs?

If you can drop the items by Tue Sep 15 (EOD PST) that will keep us on schedule for our ingestion on Sep 17.

Thanks,
Kestrel Intake Team
audit@kestrelsec.com

Kestrel / Oliver — attaching the SFTP instructions and a short bridge-letter draft for your legal team. Confirming audit period in the report: 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31 (that’s the covered period in the attached PDF).

What I’m dropping to SFTP now (per your confirmation):
- Sample change log (redacted) — change-log_q3-2026.pdf
- User access review (redacted) — access-review-2026Q2.pdf
- Incident response runbook excerpt (redacted) — IR_runbook_excerpt.pdf
- Evidence index (CSV) — evidence-index-ACME.csv

SFTP details: see sftp-credentials-instructions.txt (attached). We will provision a one-time user with expiration of 72 hours after creation. Please confirm when you have successfully pulled the files.

Bridge letter: the attached docx has a minimal paragraph we typically sign to attest coverage for data retention during the gap window — please propose edits if needed.

If Kestrel needs additional rows mapped (e.g., specific control IDs to proof files), Marissa will support with mapping snippets.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

The bridge language looks fine to our legal counsel; they made one minor wording change (tracked) and asked for a signed copy before Sep 22. I’ve forwarded the DocuSign link for the MOU to procurement (procurement@acmecloud.com) — you should see the request shortly.

Can we schedule a 30-min call with Marissa next week to walk through a couple of control mappings that Kestrel flagged? Proposed times: Mon 9/20 10:00 AM PT or Tue 9/21 2:00 PM PT.

Appreciate the quick support — will confirm once DocuSign is signed.

Best,
Oliver
Head of Procurement, Acme Cloud
